name: Quark
description: String & pad machine: divide-down strings, 89 wavetables (chord stacks and Amino's included) plus your own WAV wavetables, FM, and a sample Layer of 32 CC0 instruments (choirs, glass, flutes, sitar, koto ...), with 11 filter types, drive, detune bloom and ensemble, plus a Melody synth with a chord-following arp, multi-FX and shimmer reverb.
author: James Fish & Claude
